text:
Transformers | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be carried out on a daily 
bases as indicated by D1 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
Rated capacity | 180/240/300 MVA
High Voltage winding | 240kv
Low voltage winding | 16.5kv
Tap voltage (STEP) | 240kv + 4x2.50%
Tap changing | off load tap changer
Connection of
 polarity | YND1
Cooling method | ONAN/ONAF/ONAF
impedance | 16%
The first draft 
initiated by eng. 
Ashraf Abd El Hamid Elsayed, tested by eng. Sabri 
Ahmed Elsayed, 
revised by MDEPC Quality control eng. Adel 
Abdel Qader
El-Naggar, 
accepted by eng. Mostafa El-Klmoshy: 
general manager, approved by eng. 
Ebrahim Hassan Sector of Talkha Power station, 
certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and approved by eng. 
Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the safety and healthy equipment.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
The unit must be in service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Work to be Carried Out
Check and record the oil and winding temperature.
Check and record the oil level.
Check that the glass of level indicator is not dirty.
Check for any abnormal sound and vibration.
Check for oil leakage at any connection.
Check the discoloration of the silicagel.
Check the level of the sealing oil in oil cup.
Check the abnormal rotating sound of cooling fans.
Check the tap position is correct.
Check for any loose connection.
Check visually the extent of any contamination on the bushing.
Check indicators and relays.
Buchholz relay-check whether it is filled up with gas.
